seo.title: Studio Policies | Cancellations, Grip Socks & Arrival | KLUB
seo.description: KLUB Limassol studio policies: first-visit tips, grip socks for reformer classes, the 12-hour cancellation rule, arrival times, class-pack expiry, health, liability and privacy.

hero.heading: Studio Policies
hero.intro: Short, fair and there to keep classes running smoothly for everyone.

sections.title: First Time at KLUB
items: New to the reformer? We recommend starting with Foundations Reformer, and arriving 10 minutes early so we can introduce you to the equipment and answer any questions.
Grip socks are required for all Reformer classes — you can buy a pair at reception (€12) if you forget yours.

sections.title: Grip Socks
items: Grip socks are required for all Reformer classes — for hygiene and for safety on the equipment.
Forgot yours? Pairs are available at reception for €12.

sections.title: Arrival & Late Policy
items: Please arrive 5–10 minutes before class, and a little earlier for your very first visit so we can show you the equipment.
Late arrivals may not be permitted once class has started — for everyone's safety, and because the warm-up matters.
If you miss the start, message us and we'll help you rebook.

sections.title: Cancellation & No-Show
items: Please cancel at least 12 hours before your class and your credit is returned automatically.
Late cancellations and no-shows may result in the loss of your class credit — in a class of six, your spot matters.
Credits are not extendable. Genuine emergencies happen — talk to us.

sections.title: Class Pack Expiry
items: Monthly packs (4, 8 or 12 classes) are valid for one month.
Flexi packs (10 or 20 classes) are valid for three months from purchase.
Credits are not extendable and unused classes don't roll over.

sections.title: Respect the Space
items: Please treat the studio and equipment with care.
Return all props to where you found them after use.

sections.title: Health & Safety
items: Please tell your instructor about any injuries, pregnancy or limitations before class — it stays confidential and helps us keep you safe.
Always work at a level that feels right for your body.
Our instructors are fully certified and insured, including pre/post-natal qualification, and equipment is cleaned between every class.
Classes are attended at your own risk; KLUB cannot be held liable for injuries sustained in the studio.

sections.title: Privacy
items: We collect only the details needed to manage your bookings and keep in touch: name, contact details and any health information you choose to share.
We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
Marketing emails are opt-in and every one includes an unsubscribe link.
To access or delete your data, email team@klub-cy.com — we comply with GDPR.
